_why: O-LOCAL-SCRIPTS-PARSE-MOVED-WORKFLOWS. Two local gates broke the same way in one day (guard-sweep.mjs on 2026-09-12,
preflight.mjs on 2026-09-13): each read a detail out of a workflow by text, the workflow moved the detail, and each
computed on nothing instead of saying it could no longer see. CI was green throughout, which is why both survived.
Every script OUTSIDE .github/ and tooling/ci/ that reads a workflow by text has a row here, and each row names ONE of
the two properties the register row allows:
workflow-scan   it reads through tooling/ci/workflow-scan.mjs, the one workflow parse (checked: the file imports it)
refuses-blind   it treats 'the detail I parse is no longer there' as COVERAGE LOST / cannot-run, and `evidence` is
the exact text it prints when that happens (checked: the text is in the file)
tooling/ci/assert-workflow-readers.mjs finds the readers itself and refuses an undeclared one, a stale row, and a row
⏱ MEASURED 2026-09-14 on origin/main 39a0b633: 7 readers outside .github/ and tooling/ci/, 5 through workflow-scan.mjs
and 2 that already refuse blind. None needed converting. tooling/ci/ itself is NOT in this domain: its guards run in CI
on every change, the failure mode this register exists for is a LOCAL gate that CI does not exercise, and
assert-guard-coverage.mjs already holds every guard there to a coverage self-check.

readers.evidence: could not read the workflow that carries the e2e cron
readers.reads: the e2e cron out of extensions.yml or e2e.yml, to derive the freshness ceiling

readers.evidence: workflow file(s) parsed and NOT ONE declares a top-level
readers.reads: each workflow's top-level concurrency group and cancel-in-progress, to refuse a re-run that would evict a live run
the submission workflow the channel register names (default submit-play.yml), through parseWorkflow
the submission workflow the channel register names (default submit-snap.yml), through parseWorkflow
every tooling/ci invocation and its arguments
